title: Birth.--Childhood Recollections
author: John R. Young
note: Published 1920. Pioneer of 1847, nephew of Brigham Young. First-hand account of the trek and early Utah settlement.

footnotes.text: President Woodruff's statement makes it plain that I am wrong. My memory has become confused. It must have been some other man that father hauled home.
The horses were not Captain Preston's; they belonged to a small company of men who were returning from Oregon.
